title: Power of Four
description: Determine if a given integer n is a power of four.
pseudocode:
1. if n <= 0 return false
2. if (n & (n - 1)) != 0 return false
3. return (n & 0x55555555) != 0

steps.note: Check if n is positive. n=16 is positive.
Check if n is a power of two: 16 & 15 is 0. Condition holds.
Verify if the set bit is in an odd position (power of 4): 16 (10000) & 0x55555555 (01010101...) is 16 (non-zero). Return true.
